newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Jan-Sept trade deficit $2.3 bln.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Jan-Sept trade deficit $2.3 bln.

text.p: Hungary's accumulated trade deficit was $2.3 billion in the January-September period, unchanged from the first nine months of 1995, the Trade Ministry said on Monday.
The trade deficit was an accumulated $2.012 billion in the January-August 1996 period, according to previous ministry data.
January-to-September exports totalled $9.4 billion, up $250 million, or 2.7 percent, on the same period of 1995.
Imports over the first three quarters of this year amounted to $11.7 billion, up $300 million, or 2.6 percent, on the same period of 1995, the industry and trade ministry figures showed.
